payout_quote: Earn $300 when opening an eligible Fifth Third checking account with qualifying activities. Offer expires September 30, 2026. Your $300 offer code will be automatically applied when you select 'Open Your Account.' How to qualify: 1. Open an account - Apply online or take your offer code to a nearby branch. 2. Make direct deposits totaling $500 or more within 90 days of opening an account. 3. Enjoy your $300 - You'll get $300 within 10 business days of making your qualifying deposits. (Official Fifth Third Bank offer page, crawled 2026-09-23)
